grammar.purpose: Give a direction without claiming arrival
grammar.explanation: 朝门口走 names the direction of movement; it does not say the person has already reached the doorway. Compare 搬到门口, which specifies the resulting location. 朝这里走 depends on the speaker’s position. Verify which entrance or stairway is intended before moving a heavy object.

examples.py: cháo zhè lǐ zǒu , xiān bié shàng lóu .
examples.en: Walk this way; do not go upstairs yet.

examples.py: bān dào mén kǒu , zài tíng xià .
examples.en: Move it to the doorway and then stop.

commonMistakes.wrong: 朝门口走了，所以已经到门口了。
commonMistakes.right: 朝门口走了，还没说是否到达。
commonMistakes.why: Direction of motion does not establish the endpoint.

grammar.pattern: 出来 / 出去 / 过来 / 过去 / 回来 / 回去 / 进来 / 进去 / 起来 / 上来 / 上去 / 下来 / 下去
grammar.explanation: 来 generally directs movement toward the reference speaker, 去 away. 我在二楼，你上来 contrasts with 我在一楼，你上去. 出/进 locate movement across a boundary, 回 indicates returning, 过 crossing toward or away from a point. 起来 can mean upward movement, not necessarily toward the speaker. With a location keep it before 来/去: 搬到门口来. Ask for the reference position when unclear; do not give dangerous lifting instructions.

examples.py: wǒ zài èr lóu , nǐ shàng lái .
examples.en: I am on the second floor; come up.

examples.py: wǒ zài yī lóu , nǐ xiān shàng qù .
examples.en: I am on the first floor; go up first.

examples.zh: 把轻箱子搬到门口来，再把工具拿进去。

examples.en: Bring the light box to the doorway, then take the tools inside.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我在二楼，你从一楼下来找我。
commonMistakes.right: 我在二楼，你从一楼上来找我。
commonMistakes.why: Align upward or downward movement with the actual floors.

dialogue.title: A light box and a heavy box
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Track the floor and the speaker’s position.

lines.zh: 你在哪儿？箱子朝哪里搬？
lines.py: nǐ zài nǎr ? xiāng zi cháo nǎ lǐ bān ?
lines.en: Where are you? Which way should the boxes be moved?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我在一楼门口。先把轻箱子搬过来。
lines.py: wǒ zài yī lóu mén kǒu . xiān bǎ qīng xiāng zi bān guò lái .
lines.en: I am at the first-floor doorway. Bring the light box over first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 后面那个比较重，也搬过来吗？
lines.py: hòu miàn nà gè bǐ jiào zhòng , yě bān guò lái ma ?
lines.en: The one behind is heavier; bring it over too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先别动，等两个人一起抬。出口不能挡住。
lines.py: xiān bié dòng , děng liǎng gè rén yì qǐ tái . chū kǒu bù néng dǎng zhù .
lines.en: Leave it for now; wait for two people to lift it together. Do not block the exit.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 轻箱子里面是什么？
lines.py: qīng xiāng zi lǐ miàn shì shén me ?
lines.en: What is inside the light box?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 书和安装工具。工具先拿进去，书先放在门口。
lines.py: shū hé ān zhuāng gōng jù . gōng jù xiān ná jìn qù , shū xiān fàng zài mén kǒu .
lines.en: Books and installation tools. Take the tools inside first; leave the books at the doorway for now.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我现在上去吗？
lines.py: wǒ xiàn zài shàng qù ma ?
lines.en: Should I go upstairs now?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先在一楼等。桌子安装好以后再上去。
lines.py: xiān zài yī lóu děng . zhuō zi ān zhuāng hǎo yǐ hòu zài shàng qù .
lines.en: Wait on the first floor for now. Go upstairs after the desk is installed.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: First the tools, then the furniture
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read the movement sequence without reversing directions.

lines.zh: 我在一楼门口，请先朝这里走。
lines.py: wǒ zài yī lóu mén kǒu , qǐng xiān cháo zhè lǐ zǒu .
lines.en: I am at the first-floor doorway; walk this way first.

lines.zh: 轻箱子先搬过来，重箱子暂时不动。
lines.py: qīng xiāng zi xiān bān guò lái , zhòng xiāng zi zàn shí bù dòng .
lines.en: Bring the light box over first; leave the heavy box for now.

lines.zh: 箱子底下没有轮子，重箱子等两个人一起抬。
lines.py: xiāng zi dǐ xià méi yǒu lún zi , zhòng xiāng zi děng liǎng gè rén yì qǐ tái .
lines.en: There are no wheels beneath the box; wait for two people to lift the heavy box together.

lines.zh: 小箱子里面是工具，先拿进去；书先放在门口。
lines.py: xiǎo xiāng zi lǐ miàn shì gōng jù , xiān ná jìn qù ; shū xiān fàng zài mén kǒu .
lines.en: The small box contains tools; take them inside first, leaving the books at the doorway.

lines.zh: 背包可以背起来，箱子要装好，运输时不能散开。
lines.py: bēi bāo kě yǐ bēi qǐ lái , xiāng zi yào zhuāng hǎo , yùn shū shí bù néng sàn kāi .
lines.en: Carry the backpack on the back; pack the box properly so it does not come apart in transport.

lines.zh: 前面是入口，后面是出口，家具不能挡住出口。
lines.py: qián miàn shì rù kǒu , hòu miàn shì chū kǒu , jiā jù bù néng dǎng zhù chū kǒu .
lines.en: The entrance is in front and the exit behind; furniture must not block the exit.

lines.zh: 桌子还没安装好，先在一楼等，不要把书搬上去。
lines.py: zhuō zi hái méi ān zhuāng hǎo , xiān zài yī lóu děng , bú yào bǎ shū bān shàng qù .
lines.en: The desk is not yet installed; wait downstairs and do not carry the books up yet.

lines.zh: 外面下雨，木头和下面的纸都先留在屋里。
lines.py: wài miàn xià yǔ , mù tou hé xià miàn de zhǐ dōu xiān liú zài wū lǐ .
lines.en: It is raining outside; leave the wood and paper underneath indoors for now.
